name: Riot

text.trigger: Helpless survivors at the colony outnumber the rest.
text.vignette: The hungry crowd has noticed that the pantry door has only a padlock and that the people who guard it are outnumbered. A single shout would be enough.

options.empty: The crowd empties the pantry. All food in the supply is gone.
options.fight: Break it up by force. Every able survivor at the colony takes one wound.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1 card #49. Food drain uses -99 as "all" (track floors at 0). Needs a code hook for the helpless-outnumber test.
